probes.name: stream: the routing token goes out on the wire
probes.find: return send({ ...message, params: { ...params, _meta: rest } } as typeof message, { ...options, ...streamEnd })

probes.name: stream: every stream hears every subscription's notifications
probes.find: if (typeof id === 'string' || typeof id === 'number') sinks.get(id)?.(method, params)
probes.replace: for (const sink of sinks.values()) sink(method, params)

probes.name: stream: heartbeat silence never reconnects
probes.find: cancelWatchdog = deps.after(silence, () => settle({ kind: 'dropped', why: `no heartbeat for ${silence} ms` }))
